# ScoutLink

ScoutLink is a football intelligence product operated by Stratex Analytics. It helps grassroots coaches maintain structured U7–U16 player evidence and gives reviewed scouts controlled tools to search, compare and shortlist players.

## Canonical public information pages

- Product demo: https://www.scoutlink.app/demo
- Registration entry and Scout plans: https://www.scoutlink.app/register
- Coach registration: https://www.scoutlink.app/register/coach
- Scout access application: https://www.scoutlink.app/register/scout

## Account and secure action routes

These are functional account routes, not brochure pages and should not be indexed as general public information:

- Sign in: https://www.scoutlink.app/login
- Experience selector: https://www.scoutlink.app/experience-select
- Complete registration: https://www.scoutlink.app/complete-registration
- Scout verification: https://www.scoutlink.app/scout-verification
- Confirm Scout password: https://www.scoutlink.app/confirm-password
- Tokenised video upload: https://www.scoutlink.app/video-upload

## Redirected routes

- https://www.scoutlink.app/ redirects to /login.
- /coaches and /scouts redirect to /register.
- /scoutlink/pricing redirects to /register#plans.
- /forgot-password redirects to /login#reset.
- Safeguarding, concerns and legal-policy routes redirect to the equivalent Stratex Analytics parent-company pages.

## Public demo boundary

The public demo chooser offers Coach and Scout demos only. Those buttons open the existing isolated fictional Coach and Scout demo experiences. Demo data must never change live customer records.

## Private routes

Do not index or summarise logged-in product routes under /coach, /scout, /player, /stratex or /admin.

## Product wording

ScoutLink provides structured evidence and explainable decision support. It does not guarantee a trial, academy place, contract, signing or professional football outcome.
